dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! The weather's great today!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Hmm... although now I think about it... the weather here is the same every day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Oh, is this like a user feedback form? Ahem, time to get serious then.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: First, five stars for the environment! The view here is beyond breathtaking, I'm talking a once-in-a-lifetime kind of experience, and on top of that, there is definitely some kind of youkai power here that I can't put my finger on just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Second, five stars for comfort! I've been getting some great nights' sleep in my box.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: There's been no noise, no bright lights, no nothing! I couldn't have asked for anything more!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: And finally... another five stars for service! There's really nothing for me to nitpick in this category.

choices.text: Such a high rating... Thank you.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: You deserve all the praise! I'm the one that should be thanking you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Anything else you'd like to add?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Huh? Did I miss one? ...Oh wait, I get it — this is the open-ended question where I can mention anything that hasn't already been covered.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Alright, let me think...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: I've taken quite an interest in that huge Emerald Finch. She looks chubby and fluffy, and seems to be going through life without a care in the world...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: A teapot spirit? You mean like a Tsukumogami? Are you saying her original form is an actual teapot?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Or are you saying this is in fact her original form, but she can turn into a human girl just like me?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Ahh! This is so exciting! You have to introduce me to her!

choices.text: You are NOT allowed to eat her.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Oh, of course not, I would never do that!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: A little curiosity never hurt anyone, right? I just want to know where she comes from, what she does or thinks about, who knows, we may just end up becoming friends!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: If you get a chance, please introduce me to her!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: You've done so much work around here, it's the least I can do to tell you exactly how I feel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Sure! Is there anything you'd like to ask me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you tell me more about your job as a courier?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: You couldn't have chosen a better topic!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Delivering a high volume of packages isn't a problem for me, youkai's legs are naturally fast after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: But maintaining a good rating with clients isn't nearly as easy. Most people don't even bother to leave a review, good or bad... I guess it's human nature to avoid doing anything that isn't absolutely necessary?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Yet, despite that... I've noticed that when I'm a cat, passers-by always stop and stare at me like they have nothing better to do, even if I'm just sunbathing. But as soon as I turn into a human being, suddenly no one has two minutes to spare to leave a good rating. Weird, isn't it?

choices.text: Do you ever get tired from working?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hmm... depends. Sometimes, I guess — especially leading up to festivals, when the express packages start piling up like a bunch of Zaytun Peaches about to burst...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: If only my youkai powers were stronger... maybe then I'd be able to run even faster. Hehe, or maybe even split myself into a ton of different clones!

choices.text: So one nekomata with two tails...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Argh, stop with the math! I'm gonna tie my tails in knots trying to keep up!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sound really passionate about your work.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Why wouldn't I be? After all, this job has allowed me to visit and find my place in all kinds of human cities!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: You could say that taking my job seriously is my way to show my gratitude!

choices.text: Would become three nekomata with six tails...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hehe, you're looking at the only gold level courier of Komaniya Express!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: My boss even wanted to give me a special bonus! I told them though that I'd still prefer more paid-for international vacations, uh, I mean, opportunities to deliver international packages.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Yes! There's something I've been meaning to ask you for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: #{M#Do you know what styles human girls are into these days?}{F#One girl to another... do you have any fashion tips you could share with me?}

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Too sudden? My bad, my bad! Alright then, allow me to explain the situation from the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: As you're already aware, even though I am a youkai, I've been looked after by my human Granny since a very early age.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: It goes without saying that I've heard way more stories about humans than I did about the youkai. I've always looked forward to joining the colorful and warm world that is human society!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: But even after I managed to use my youkai powers to give myself a human form, I still didn't know how to fit in. It would be a bit awkward for me to still dress and act like a nekomata when I'd already changed my look...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I began to observe human girls to see what they liked to wear. It seemed to me that everyone really liked bows and flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: And so, I added a ton on my own clothes!

choices.text: They look really cute on you!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: You really think so? Aw, thanks! *purr*

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: So um... would you be willing to accompany me to go on a little shopping spree whenever you're free?

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: I'd love to buy some cute accessories, and with an expert like you by my side, nothing can go wrong!

choices.text: You could add a few more accessories to match with your outfit.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Whoa! A fashion connoisseur? I knew I came to the right person!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Kirara.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}! How do I look? 'Cause I feel pretty good!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Oh, but don't worry — just because I'm feeling perky doesn't mean I'm gonna hunt any of your finches! Promise!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Kirara.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Nighty night! There's just one last thing — and I'm not saying you will, but if you do end up hearing some crunching noises in your dreams... just know that it's perfectly normal.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Ugh, fine, I—I'll try my best not to eat anything in the middle of the night.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I love these kinds of streets! They're always super lively and beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I especially love climbing onto the roof and looking down at the crowd going about their day. It's incredibly fascinating to me!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Actually, while you're here, why don't you also give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: These two trees look insanely sturdy! The foliage is also surprisingly dense.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Just imagine... how cozy would it be if we could climb up there and take a nap?

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: The subtle breeze blowing on the leaves, coupled with the sound of water coming from the fountain... Ah— I swear, I'm feeling sleepy already...
